$description: Tale Forge (https://tale-forge.app) design tokens, W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) style: $type/$value groups. Captured 2026-10-09/10. Values are the shipped CSS literals (8-digit #rrggbbaa hex, rem/em, clamp()), so they paste back into CSS; composite types (shadow, gradient, typography, cubicBezier) are split into DTCG objects and the original CSS string is kept in $extensions["app.tale-forge"].css. Theme tokens carry both modes in $extensions["app.tale-forge"].modes; $value is the natt (default) value. Names in "theme" are the site's own custom properties without the leading "--"; every other name is ours. Line citations: "3q17cp_jgfwol.pretty.css:N" = source/css/3q17cp_jgfwol.pretty.css line N (library-relative). Companions: tokens.css, tokens.ts.
